an10.94:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an10.94:1.2: athakho vajjiyamāhito gahapati divādivassa campāya nikkhami bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
an10.94:1.8: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti
an10.94:2.1: athakho vajjiyamāhito gahapati yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami.
an10.94:2.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṃgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentā nisinnā honti
an10.94:3.1: addasaṃsu kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ disvāna aññamaññaṃ sañṭhapesuṃ
an10.94:3.2: appasaddā bhonto hontu mā bhonto saddamakattha
an10.94:3.3: ayaṃ vajjiyamāhito gahapati āgacchati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako
an10.94:3.4: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā campāyaṃ paṭivasanti ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro vajjiyamāhito gahapati
an10.94:3.5: appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino
an10.94:3.6: appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti
an10.94:4.2: athakho vajjiyamāhito gahapati yena paribbājakā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi
an10.94:4.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ te paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
an10.94:4.4: saccaṃ kira gahapati samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadatīti.
an10.94:4.5: na kho bhante bhagavā sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati napi sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadati
an10.94:4.6: gārayhaṃ kho bhante bhagavā garahati pasaṃsiyaṃ pasaṃsati
an10.94:4.7: gārayhaṃ kho pana bhante bhagavā garahanto pasaṃsiyaṃ pasaṃsanto vibhajavādī bhagavā
an10.94:5.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro paribbājako vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
an10.94:5.2: āgamehi tvaṃ gahapati yassa tvaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsasi so samaṇo gotamo venayiko appaññattikoti.
an10.94:6.1: evaṃ vutte paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṃkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhāṇā nisīdiṃsu.
an10.94:6.2: athakho vajjiyamāhito gahapati te paribbājake tuṇhībhūte maṃkubhūte pattakkhandhe adhomukhe pajjhāyante appaṭibhāṇe viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi
an10.94:6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vajjiyamāhito gahapati yāvatako ahosi tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an10.94:7.2: evaṃ kho te gahapati moghapurisā kālena kālaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetabbā
an10.94:7.3: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ tapaṃ tapitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:7.4: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ tapaṃ na tapitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:7.5: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ samādānaṃ samāditabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:7.6: na panāhaṃ gahapati samādānaṃ na samāditabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:7.7: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:7.8: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:7.9: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭinissajjitabboti vadāmi
an10.94:7.10: na panāhaṃ gahapati paṭinissaggaṃ na paṭinissajjitabboti vadāmi
an10.94:7.11: nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ vimuttiṃ vimuccitabbāti vadāmi
an10.94:7.12: na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ vimuttiṃ na vimuccitabbāti vadāmi
an10.94:8.1: yañhi gahapati tapaṃ tapato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ tapaṃ na tapitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:8.2: yañca khvāssa gahapati tapaṃ tapato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ tapaṃ tapitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:9.1: yañhi gahapati samādānaṃ samādayato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ samādānaṃ na samāditabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:9.2: yañca khvāssa gahapati samādānaṃ samādayato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ samādānaṃ samāditabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:10.1: yañhi gahapati padhānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:10.2: yañca khvāssa gahapati padhānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabbanti vadāmi
an10.94:11.1: yañhi gahapati paṭinissaggaṃ paṭinissajjato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpo paṭinissaggo na paṭinissajjitabboti vadāmi
an10.94:11.2: yañca khvāssa gahapati paṭinissaggaṃ paṭinissajjato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpo paṭinissaggo paṭinissajjitabboti vadāmi
an10.94:12.1: yañhi gahapati vimuttiṃ vimuccato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpā vimutti na vimuccitabbāti vadāmi
an10.94:12.2: yañca khvāssa gahapati vimuttiṃ vimuccato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpā vimutti vimuccitabbāti vadāmīti.
an10.94:13.1: athakho vajjiyamāhito gahapati bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an10.94:14.1: athakho bhagavā acirapakkante vajjiyamāhite gahapatimhi bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.94:14.2: yopi kho bhikkhu dīgharattaṃ apparajakkho imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sopi evamevaṃ aññatitthiye paribbājake sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggaheyya yathātaṃ vajjiyamāhitena gahapatinā niggahitāti.
